label: Printful
terms_note: API terms apply (not read); no anti-automation clause seen

fields.name: token
fields.help: Printful private (store-level) token or OAuth access token, sent as `Authorization: Bearer`. Account-level tokens also need the X-PF-Store-Id header, which the runtime cannot send: use a store token.

me.note: GET /oauth/scopes returns the scopes of the token ({code, result: {scopes: [{scope, display_name}]}}).

list_products.note: Printful catalog products (blanks): GET /products?category_id=… returns the whole catalog in one {code, result[]} response (about 550 products). The catalog OpenAPI (https://developers.printful.com/docs/openapi.json) defines only category_id, and a live check (auth audit 2026-09-26, public endpoint) showed offset ignored and no paging object, so page/limit are not sent. `query` is not accepted; `category` maps to category_id.

get_product.note: result.product; the variants [{id, name, size, color, price, currency, in_stock}] are in the sibling result.variants (not in `raw`, which is the product only).

create_order.note: Creates a DRAFT order (the `confirm` query parameter is not sent), so nothing is charged until the order is confirmed in Printful. `shipping_address` is Printful's recipient object {name, address1, city, state_code, country_code, zip, phone, email}; `items` are Printful items [{variant_id|sync_variant_id, quantity, files[{url}]}]; `shipping_option` is the shipping method id.

not_offered.quote_shipping: POST /shipping/rates takes nested recipient{address1, city, country_code, state_code, zip} + items[{variant_id, quantity}]; the vocabulary's product_id/country/quantity cannot be shaped into that body by the runtime's flat body form.
not_offered.track: No tracking-events endpoint; shipments[{tracking_number, tracking_url, carrier, service}] are part of GET /orders/{id} (see get_order).

evidence: host api.printful.com: DNS ok, TLSv1.3 (DigiCert Inc)
probe: 5/5 tools answered on their documented path with an auth refusal, a validation error or data; control route answered 401 too, so the host authenticates before routing
spec https://developers.printful.com/docs/openapi.json: 5/5 tools match (path, method, parameters, body keys, response paths)
live read without credentials: get_product, list_products returned data that validates against the vocabulary
auth_audit.notes: Fixed: list_products no longer sends offset/limit (not in the catalog spec; live, offset was ignored and no paging object came back).
